text: O Vrishanka, while you long for the flight of arrows, the task for us is ready to be accomplished by you. Now, know that this is exactly what the enemies strongly desire from the one who partakes in the sacrificial offerings. Indeed, the gods behold these armies, born of prowess, for your victory. And he, who is a divine being and whose soul is merged in the Absolute, can be subdued by your single strike.
